rows.grounds: locative plural indicating the vast number in which torment occurs
compound denoting the devices or realms of birth
past passive participle describing beings subjected to suffering

items.question: What vast scope of womb-mechanisms subjects beings to torment?
premises: The quantity specified is eighty-four thousand.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across an immense array of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The tormented subjects are not explicitly named in this verse and are inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
